/// A variable axis of a `Font`, such as weight or width.
export class FontAxis {
    /// Four letter axis tag, for example "wght".
    tag: string = "";

    /// Smallest value the axis accepts.
    min: f32 = 0;

    /// Value the axis takes when not set.
    default_: f32 = 0;

    /// Largest value the axis accepts.
    max: f32 = 0;
}

/// A font that shapes and draws text. Fonts come from the file's assets with
/// `context.font(name)`, from a view model `PropertyFont`, or from bytes with
/// `Font.decode`. Metrics are for a 1 point font and grow negative upwards,
/// so multiply by the size and expect `ascent` below zero.
/// ```as
/// export class Label extends Node {
///     text: Text = new Text();
///
///     override init(context: Context): bool {
///         let font = context.font("Inter");
///         if (font != null) {
///             let style = new TextRunStyle(font);
///             style.size = 24;
///             style.paint = new Paint();
///             this.text.append("Hello", style);
///         }
///         return true;
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export class Font {
    /// Distance from the baseline to the top of the em box for a 1 point
    /// font, negative.
    ascent: f32 = 0;

    /// Distance from the baseline to the bottom of the em box for a 1 point
    /// font.
    descent: f32 = 0;

    /// Distance from the baseline to the top of capital letters, negative.
    capHeight: f32 = 0;

    /// Distance from the baseline to the top of lowercase letters, negative.
    xHeight: f32 = 0;

    /// Decodes a TrueType or OpenType font from bytes a script obtained
    /// itself, such as a downloaded file. Font files in a project are font
    /// assets, reached with `context.font`. Returns `null` when the bytes
    /// are not a font.
    /// ```as
    /// let downloadedBytes = new ArrayBuffer(0);
    /// let font = Font.decode(downloadedBytes);
    /// ```
    static unsafe decode(bytes: ArrayBuffer): Font?;

    /// Weight from 1 to 1000, 400 being regular.
    get weight(): u32;

    /// Whether the font is italic.
    get isItalic(): bool;

    /// Height of one line of text at the given size.
    lineHeight(size: f32): f32;

    /// Whether the font has a glyph for the unicode codepoint.
    hasGlyph(codepoint: u32): bool;

    /// Current value of a variable axis, by tag.
    axisValue(tag: string): f32;

    /// Variable axes the font offers.
    unsafe axes(): Array<FontAxis>;

    /// Four letter OpenType feature tags the font offers, such as "liga".
    unsafe features(): Array<string>;

    /// A new font at the given axis values and feature settings, both keyed
    /// by four letter tag.
    /// ```as
    /// let axes = new Map<string, f32>();
    /// axes.set("wght", 700);
    /// let features = new Map<string, u32>();
    /// features.set("liga", 0);
    /// let bold = font.withOptions(axes, features);
    /// ```
    unsafe withOptions(axes: Map<string, f32>? = null, features: Map<string, u32>? = null): Font;

    /// Outline of one glyph in 1 point units with the baseline at y 0, wound
    /// for a clockwise fill. Scale by the font size to draw it.
    unsafe glyphPath(glyphId: u32): Path;

    /// Releases the font. A font read from a `Glyph` belongs to its `Text`
    /// and is left alone.
    release(): void;
}

/// How a `Text` sizes its box.
export const enum TextSizing {
    /// The box grows to fit the text, which wraps only at newlines.
    autoWidth = 0,

    /// The width is `maxWidth` and the height grows to fit the text.
    autoHeight = 1,

    /// The box is `maxWidth` by `maxHeight`.
    fixed = 2,
}

/// What a `Text` does with text that does not fit its box.
export const enum TextOverflow {
    /// Overflowing text still draws.
    visible = 0,

    /// Lines that do not fit are hidden.
    hidden = 1,

    /// Text is clipped to the box.
    clipped = 2,

    /// The last line that fits ends with an ellipsis.
    ellipsis = 3,
}

/// Horizontal alignment of each line in a `Text`.
export const enum TextAlign {
    /// Aligns lines to the left edge.
    left = 0,

    /// Aligns lines to the right edge.
    right = 1,

    /// Centers lines.
    center = 2,

    /// Aligns lines to the edge where the first paragraph starts, so right
    /// to left text starts on the right.
    start = 3,

    /// Aligns lines to the edge where the first paragraph ends.
    end = 4,
}

/// Whether a `Text` wraps lines at its width.
export const enum TextWrap {
    /// Lines wrap at the box width.
    wrap = 0,

    /// Lines break only at newlines.
    noWrap = 1,
}

/// How a word that does not fit its line may be split.
export const enum TextWordBreak {
    /// Moves the word to its own line and only cuts it when it still does
    /// not fit there.
    breakWord = 0,

    /// Never cuts a word; one that does not fit even on a line of its own
    /// overflows the box.
    normal = 1,

    /// Cuts at any character so every line is packed to the edge.
    breakAll = 2,
}

/// Where y 0 sits in a `Text`'s local space.
export const enum TextOrigin {
    /// At the top of the first line.
    top = 0,

    /// On the baseline of the first line.
    baseline = 1,
}

/// Writing direction of a `Text`, a paragraph or a glyph run.
export const enum TextDirection {
    /// Detects each paragraph's direction from its text.
    auto = 0,

    /// Left to right.
    ltr = 1,

    /// Right to left.
    rtl = 2,
}

/// Style of one run appended to a `Text`.
/// ```as
/// let style = new TextRunStyle(font);
/// style.size = 24;
/// style.paint = paint;
/// text.append("Hello", style);
/// ```
export class TextRunStyle {
    /// Font the run is shaped with.
    font: Font;

    /// Font size, 16 by default.
    size: f32 = 16;

    /// Line height, or the font's own when negative, the default.
    lineHeight: f32 = -1;

    /// Extra space added after each glyph.
    letterSpacing: f32 = 0;

    /// Runs sharing a paint draw as one path. A run without a paint only
    /// draws when `Text.draw` is given one.
    paint: Paint? = null;

    /// Color used by emoji layers that take the text color.
    foregroundColor: Color = 0xFF000000;

    /// Creates a style for `font` with the default size and spacing.
    constructor(font: Font);
}

    index: u32;

    baseline: f32;

    bottom: f32;

    /// Base direction of the paragraph the line belongs to, `ltr` or `rtl`.
    direction: TextDirection;

    /// UTF-16 code unit index of the first character on the line.

    /// UTF-16 code unit index of the last character on the line.

    /// Width of the line, the sum of its glyph advances.

    /// The glyph at a zero based visual position.

    /// All glyphs in visual order.
    glyphs(): Array<Glyph>;
}

/// Shapes and lays out styled runs of text with the runtime's shaper, so
/// scripts get real line breaking and bidirectional ordering. Append runs,
/// set the box, then draw it in one call or walk its lines and glyphs to
/// draw them yourself. Indices are zero based UTF-16 code units, like
/// `string` indices.
/// ```as
/// export class Label extends Node {
///     text: Text = new Text();
///     paint: Paint = new Paint();
///
///     override init(context: Context): bool {
///         let font = context.font("IBM Plex Sans Arabic");
///         if (font == null) {
///             return false;
///         }
///         let style = new TextRunStyle(font);
///         style.size = 32;
///         style.paint = this.paint;
///         this.text.append("مرحبا بالعالم", style);
///         this.text.sizing = TextSizing.fixed;
///         this.text.maxWidth = 240;
///         this.text.align = TextAlign.start;
///         return true;
///     }
///
///     override draw(renderer: Renderer): void {
///         this.text.draw(renderer);
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export class Text {
    /// Increments on every change, so lines and glyphs read earlier can tell
    /// they went stale.
    revision: u32 = 0;

    /// Creates an empty text.
    constructor();

    /// How the text sizes its box, `autoWidth` by default.
    get sizing(): TextSizing;
    set sizing(value: TextSizing);

    /// What happens to text that does not fit the box, `visible` by default.
    get overflow(): TextOverflow;
    set overflow(value: TextOverflow);

    /// Horizontal alignment of each line, `left` by default.
    get align(): TextAlign;
    set align(value: TextAlign);

    /// Whether lines wrap at the box width, `wrap` by default.
    get wrap(): TextWrap;
    set wrap(value: TextWrap);

    /// How a word that does not fit its line may be split, `breakWord` by
    /// default.
    get wordBreak(): TextWordBreak;
    set wordBreak(value: TextWordBreak);

    /// Where y 0 sits, `top` by default.
    get origin(): TextOrigin;
    set origin(value: TextOrigin);

    /// Base writing direction, `auto` by default.
    get direction(): TextDirection;
    set direction(value: TextDirection);

    /// Wrap width when sizing is not `autoWidth`.
    get maxWidth(): f32;
    set maxWidth(value: f32);

    /// Height the text overflows at when sizing is `fixed`.
    get maxHeight(): f32;
    set maxHeight(value: f32);

    /// Space between paragraphs separated by a newline.
    get paragraphSpacing(): f32;
    set paragraphSpacing(value: f32);

    /// Number of UTF-16 code units appended.
    get length(): i32;

    /// Whether no text has been appended.
    get isEmpty(): bool;

    /// Appends a styled run. Runs join into one string; a newline starts a
    /// paragraph.
    /// ```as
    /// let style = new TextRunStyle(font);
    /// style.paint = paint;
    /// text.append("Hello, ", style);
    /// text.append("world", style);
    /// ```
    append(text: string, style: TextRunStyle): void;

    /// Removes every run.
    clear(): void;

    /// Draws every run with its own paint, or all of them with the given
    /// paint.
    draw(renderer: Renderer, paint: Paint? = null): void;

    /// Minimum and maximum corner of the laid out text.
    /// ```as
    /// let bounds = text.bounds();
    /// let width = bounds.v1.x - bounds.v0.x;
    /// ```
    unsafe bounds(): ArtboardBounds;

    /// Number of lines after layout.
    get lineCount(): i32;

    /// The line at a zero based index, top to bottom.
    line(index: i32): TextLine;

    /// Every line, top to bottom.
    lines(): Array<TextLine>;

    /// The UTF-16 code unit index nearest a point in the text's local space.
    hitTest(position: Vector): i32;

    /// The caret before the code unit at `index`, as three values: its x, top
    /// and bottom. Returns `null` when the text has no layout.
    /// ```as
    /// let caret = text.caret(0);
    /// if (caret != null) {
    ///     let x = caret[0];
    ///     let height = caret[2] - caret[1];
    /// }
    /// ```
    unsafe caret(index: i32): StaticArray<f32>?;

    /// Rectangles covering the code units from one index to another, one per
    /// glyph, as consecutive minimum and maximum corners.
    /// ```as
    /// let corners = text.selectionRects(0, 5);
    /// for (let i = 0; i + 1 < corners.length; i += 2) {
    ///     let min = corners[i];
    ///     let max = corners[i + 1];
    /// }
    /// ```
    unsafe selectionRects(from: i32, to: i32): Array<Vector>;

    /// Releases the text and its layout.
    release(): void;
}
